rendered: The 1.4 Ah[1] pouch cell was charged and discharged at 1 C/2 C[2] rates for 1000 cycles[3], and its capacity degraded to 65.7%[4] of its initial capacity. Lithium content of the NMC622 cathode, measured by ICP-OES, was reduced from 1.015[5] to 0.993[6] after delamination, a fall of 2.17[7] percent, which the authors attribute mostly to lithium leaching during the delamination and washing steps.
